description: Defines the TaskService class for managing MIDI task runners with thread safety, including methods for binding/unbinding instances, posting tasks, and managing task runners.

classes.name: midi::TaskService
classes.description: Manages MIDI task runners, providing thread-safe task posting and instance management.

methods.name: BindInstance
methods.description: Binds a new instance ID for posting tasks; returns true if successful.

methods.name: UnbindInstance
methods.description: Unbinds the current instance ID; returns true if successful.

methods.name: IsOnTaskRunner
methods.description: Checks if current thread belongs to specified task runner.

methods.name: PostStaticTask
methods.description: Posts a task to a specified task runner without binding.

methods.name: PostBoundTask
methods.description: Posts a task bound to the current instance.

methods.name: PostBoundDelayedTask
methods.description: Posts a delayed task bound to the current instance.

methods.name: OverflowInstanceIdForTesting
methods.description: For testing purposes, overflows the instance ID.
